apple.name: FieldLog: Site Notes & Tasks
apple.subtitle: Keep your project work in sync
apple.promotionalText: Keep site notes, photos, tasks, and checklists together. Save a draft offline, review your team's progress, and share a clear record of the work.
apple.description:
Keep a clear record of work, wherever the day takes your team. FieldLog brings project notes, photos, tasks, and checklists into one place for small teams working on site.

CAPTURE THE DETAILS
Add dated notes and photos to a project. Keep useful context with the work so your team can follow what happened and what comes next.

KEEP WORK MOVING
Assign tasks, work through checklists, and review project activity and progress. Open an assignment from its notification and return to the right task.

MAKE ROOM FOR OFFLINE WORK
Save drafts when a connection is unavailable. Review pending or failed actions, retry uploads, and resolve conflicting edits when your team works on the same record.

SHARE THE RECORD
Create a project report and share it using your device's native sharing tools. Keep notes, photos, and progress together when it is time to hand work over.

BUILT AROUND YOUR DAY
Find a project, capture an entry, check the site map, and get back to work. Choose when to grant access to photos, camera, location, and notifications for the features you use.

An account and project workspace are required for team features. An internet connection is required to sign in and sync; offline drafts and queued work sync when connectivity returns.

googlePlay.title: FieldLog: Site Notes & Tasks
googlePlay.shortDescription: Project notes, photos, tasks, and checklists for small teams on site.
googlePlay.fullDescription:
Keep a clear record of project work with FieldLog. Bring site notes, photos, assigned tasks, and checklists together so your small team can follow the work from the first entry to the handover.

Record the details
Capture dated notes and attach photos to a project. Keep the context of the work close to the record.

Coordinate the next step
Assign and complete tasks, work through checklists, and review recent project activity and progress. Assignment notifications take you to the relevant task.

Work around a weak connection
Save a draft offline and review actions waiting to sync. Retry failed uploads and resolve conflicting edits when teammates update the same record.

Share a useful handover
Generate a project report and share it through your device's native sharing tools. Keep the record of notes, photos, and completed work together.

Use native device tools
Capture or choose a photo, find the site on a map, and choose which features can access your camera, photos, location, or notifications.

An account and project workspace are required for team features. Sign-in and syncing need an internet connection. Offline drafts and queued work sync when connectivity returns.

publicationChecklist.requirement: Product owner verifies every advertised feature against the exact submitted FieldLog build and removes unsupported copy.
FieldLog uses immutable published Mixer packages from its separate consumer repository; local source links do not qualify.
Complete required iOS and Android physical-device flows and release receipts. Phones are disconnected; do not attempt device runs until the user changes that instruction.
Confirm app-name availability, bundle/package identity, legal publisher, category, countries, locale, age rating, and reviewed minimum OS support.
Publish the app-specific privacy policy, support contact, and account-deletion path; reconcile Apple App Privacy and Google Data safety with actual app and SDK behavior.
Capture actual submitted UI per platform, sanitize data, validate image dimensions/format, review text legibility, and provide supported tablet assets where required.
Provide a working review account and complete feature/update review notes; assess actual update behavior against current Apple and Google policy.
Product owner decides whether FieldLog charges users and supplies any required purchase, restore, subscription, and regional disclosures. No paid offering is implied by this draft.
Complete signing, processing, store review, backend/support readiness, and accountable release approval before adding actual store URLs or install badges.
